verifyPage.title: Verify Student
verifyPage.description: Verify your student status to get discounted prices for all our events.

status.verificationSuccessDescription: Your verification is complete. You can now use student pricing where available.

validation.schoolNameMin: School name must be at least 2 characters

notes.title: Verification notes
notes.item1: • Student discounts apply to accredited colleges and universities.
notes.item2: • We will send you an email for verification.
notes.item3: • You may be asked to confirm your active enrollment status.

errors.invalidEduEmail: We cannot verify that your edu email is valid, please contact VVF technical team at tech@vietvibe.org, we will reply to you in 24hrs.
errors.unexpectedVerificationError: An unexpected error occurred while verifying student status.

termsPage.title: Student Discount Terms and Conditions
termsPage.intro: These terms apply to all student discount benefits offered by Viet Vibe Foundation.
termsPage.eligibility: You must be an actively enrolled student at an accredited college or university to qualify for student pricing.
termsPage.verification: Student verification may require a valid school email and additional confirmation of enrollment status.
termsPage.usage: Discounts are non-transferable, may not be combined with other promotions unless stated, and can be changed or removed at any time.
termsPage.contact: If you have questions about your eligibility or verification status, please contact us at tech@vietvibe.org.
